answer_2.quote: we use role-level micro precision, recall, and F1 for evaluation

answer_4.quote: We manually evaluate the quality of learned guidelines. We manually evaluate the following aspects of responses from Reasoner: 1. relevant: whether the rules referred to by the model are truly relevant to the instance; 2. well-referred: whether the model genuinely follows the rules
answer_4.guideline: We assess if each guideline is precise and unambiguous, counting a hit if the guideline is precise and unambiguous.
